name: Herrscherin of Hell: Puppeteer's Gambit
source:
After returning from the human world, the demoness decides to amuse herself by stiring up some chaos in her native realm, Hell, going as far as challenging one of the fellow Herrscherins. 

Will she succeed in her conquest, or will she fall victim to her own schemes? 

[From [url=https://fallen-pie.itch.io/herrscherin-of-hell-puppeteers-gambit]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
从人类世界回来后，恶魔决定在她的家乡地狱中挑起一些混乱来取乐，甚至挑战了一位赫尔舍林同伴。

她会成功征服，还是会成为自己阴谋的受害者？

[来自[url=https://fallen-pie.itch.io/herrscherin-of-hell-puppeteers-gambit]Itch.io[/url]]
